steps.text: 1871: Ill and destitute at Ujiji on Lake Tanganyika, he was found by Henry Morton Stanley: "Dr Livingstone, I presume?"
steps.text_zh: 1871年，在坦噶尼喀湖畔的乌吉吉贫病交加时，被斯坦利找到，留下“您就是利文斯通博士吧？”的名句。

steps.place_zh: 班韦乌卢湖附近的奇坦博
steps.text: 1873: Died at Chitambo's village; his companions Susi and Chuma buried his heart there and carried his body to the coast, and he was buried in Westminster Abbey.
steps.text_zh: 1873年，死于奇坦博村。随从苏西和朱马把他的心脏葬在当地，将遗体运到海岸，最终安葬于威斯敏斯特教堂。

title: Ibn Khaldun's life journey
summary: A Tunisian scholar-statesman who served courts from Granada to Cairo, wrote the Muqaddimah in a desert castle and met Timur outside Damascus.
summary_zh: 突尼斯学者兼政治家，辗转于格拉纳达至开罗的诸宫廷，在荒野城堡中写成《历史绪论》，晚年在大马士革城外会见帖木儿。

steps.text: 1332: Born in Tunis to a family of Andalusian origin; the Black Death of 1348 killed his parents and many of his teachers.
steps.text_zh: 1332年，生于突尼斯，祖上来自安达卢斯。1348年黑死病夺走了他的父母和许多老师。

steps.text: 1354: Joined the Marinid court at Fez as a secretary; caught up in intrigue, he spent nearly two years in prison.
steps.text_zh: 1354年，到非斯马林王朝宫廷任文书，卷入宫廷阴谋，坐了近两年牢。

steps.text: 1362: Moved to Nasrid Granada, where he was welcomed by the sultan and his vizier, the poet Ibn al-Khatib.
steps.text_zh: 1362年，前往纳斯里王朝的格拉纳达，受到苏丹及其宰相、诗人伊本·赫提卜的礼遇。

steps.text: 1364: Sent as envoy to Pedro the Cruel of Castile in Seville, his ancestors' city; Pedro offered to restore the family's lands if he stayed, but he declined.
steps.text_zh: 1364年，出使塞维利亚觐见卡斯蒂利亚的“残酷者”佩德罗，这里是他祖先的故城。佩德罗许诺归还祖产请他留下，他婉拒了。

steps.text: 1365: Became chief minister to the Hafsid ruler of Béjaïa, then spent years moving between Maghrib courts and tribes.
steps.text_zh: 1365年，出任贝贾亚哈夫斯王朝统治者的首席大臣，此后多年辗转于马格里布各宫廷和部落之间。

steps.text: 1377: In the castle of Qal'at Ibn Salama, where he had retreated in 1375, he completed the Muqaddimah, his pioneering theory of history and society.
steps.text_zh: 1377年，在1375年隐居的伊本·萨拉马堡写成《历史绪论》，开创了历史与社会理论的先河。

steps.text: 1378: Returned to Tunis to work in its libraries on his universal history, the Kitab al-Ibar.
steps.text_zh: 1378年，回到突尼斯，借助当地藏书撰写通史《殷鉴书》。

steps.text: 1382: Left for the pilgrimage and settled in Mamluk Cairo, where he taught and was named chief Maliki judge; his family drowned in a shipwreck on their way to join him.
steps.text_zh: 1382年，以朝觐为名离开突尼斯，定居马穆鲁克治下的开罗，讲学并出任马立克派首席法官。家人赶来与他团聚时遇海难全部遇难。

steps.text: 1387: Made the pilgrimage to Mecca, then returned to Cairo.
steps.text_zh: 1387年，前往麦加朝觐，之后回到开罗。

steps.text: 1401: Accompanying the Mamluk army to besieged Damascus, he was lowered over the walls to meet Timur, with whom he talked for weeks; he left a vivid record of the conqueror.
steps.text_zh: 1401年，随马穆鲁克军队到被围的大马士革，从城墙上缒下与帖木儿会面，交谈达数周之久，留下关于这位征服者的生动记述。

steps.text: 1406: Died in Cairo, having served several more terms as chief judge.
steps.text_zh: 1406年，在开罗去世，此前又数度出任首席法官。

title: Vasco da Gama's voyages
summary: The Portuguese captain who opened the sea route from Europe round Africa to India, returned with force in 1502 and died as viceroy in India.
summary_zh: 葡萄牙船长，开辟了绕过非洲通往印度的航路，1502年武力重返，最终以印度副王身份死于当地。

steps.text: 1469: Born in the Atlantic port of Sines, son of its royal governor (birth year approximate).
steps.text_zh: 1469年前后，生于大西洋港口锡尼什，父亲是当地王室长官（生年为约数）。

steps.text: 1497: Sailed from Belém on 8 July with four ships, ordered by King Manuel to reach India by sea.
steps.text_zh: 1497年7月8日，奉曼努埃尔国王之命，率四艘船从贝伦启航，寻找通往印度的海路。

steps.text: 1497: After a record three months out of sight of land in the South Atlantic, he rounded the Cape of Good Hope in November.
steps.text_zh: 1497年，在南大西洋远离陆地航行三个月，创下纪录，11月绕过好望角。

steps.text: 1498: Reached Mozambique Island, entering the Muslim trading world of the Swahili coast, where relations quickly turned hostile.
steps.text_zh: 1498年，抵达莫桑比克岛，进入斯瓦希里海岸的穆斯林贸易圈，与当地关系很快恶化。

steps.text: 1498: The sultan of Malindi, rival of Mombasa, welcomed him and provided a pilot to guide him across the Indian Ocean.
steps.text_zh: 1498年，与蒙巴萨不和的马林迪苏丹热情接待他，并派领航员带他横渡印度洋。

steps.text: 1498: Landed near Calicut in May, the first European to reach India by sea, though his poor gifts unimpressed the Zamorin.
steps.text_zh: 1498年5月，在卡利卡特附近登陆，成为第一个从海路抵达印度的欧洲人，但他带的礼物太寒酸，没能打动扎莫林。

steps.text: 1499: Returned to Lisbon with two ships and a cargo of spices, having lost about half his men, and was richly rewarded.
steps.text_zh: 1499年，带着两艘船和一批香料回到里斯本，船员折损约一半，受到重赏。

steps.text: 1502: Leading a heavily armed second fleet, he forced the sultan of Kilwa to pay tribute to Portugal.
steps.text_zh: 1502年，率重兵第二次远航，迫使基尔瓦苏丹向葡萄牙纳贡。

steps.text: 1502: Burned a pilgrim ship off the Malabar coast with its passengers and bombarded Calicut, then loaded spices at Cochin.
steps.text_zh: 1502年，在马拉巴尔海岸外焚烧一艘满载朝觐者的船只，炮轰卡利卡特，随后到科钦装载香料。

steps.text: 1524: After two decades at home, he was sent back as viceroy of Portuguese India to clean up corruption, arriving in Goa in September.
steps.text_zh: 1524年，在国内闲居二十年后，奉命出任葡属印度副王整顿腐败，9月抵达果阿。

steps.text: 1524: Fell ill and died in Cochin on Christmas Eve; his remains were later taken back to Portugal.
steps.text_zh: 1524年平安夜，在科钦病逝，遗骨后来运回葡萄牙。

title: Leo Africanus's travels
title_zh: 利奥·阿非利加努斯一生行迹
summary: A Granada-born Moroccan diplomat who travelled to Timbuktu and Cairo, was captured by corsairs, and wrote in Rome the book that taught Europe about Africa.
summary_zh: 生于格拉纳达的摩洛哥外交使节，到过廷巴克图和开罗，被海盗掳走后在罗马写成向欧洲介绍非洲的名著。

steps.text: 1494: Born al-Hasan al-Wazzan in Granada, probably around this year, just after the city fell to Castile.
steps.text_zh: 1494年前后，生于格拉纳达，原名哈桑·瓦赞，此前不久该城刚落入卡斯蒂利亚之手。

steps.text: 1500: His family emigrated to Fez while he was a child (date approximate); he studied there and entered the Wattasid sultan's service.
steps.text_zh: 1500年前后，幼年随家人移居非斯（年代为约数），在当地求学，后为瓦塔斯王朝苏丹效力。

steps.text: 1510: By his own account he went with his uncle on an embassy to Timbuktu around this year, and later travelled in the lands of Songhai.
steps.text_zh: 1510年前后，据他自述随叔父出使廷巴克图，后来又游历桑海帝国各地。

steps.text: 1517: On missions to the east he was in Egypt around the time of the Ottoman conquest, and described Cairo at length.
steps.text_zh: 1517年前后，出使东方期间正值奥斯曼征服埃及之际身在当地，后来对开罗作了详尽描写。

steps.text: 1520: Seized by Christian corsairs in 1518 and given to Pope Leo X, he was baptised in St Peter's as Johannes Leo de Medicis.
steps.text_zh: 1520年，他在1518年被基督徒海盗掳获，献给教皇利奥十世，此时在圣彼得大教堂受洗，取名约翰内斯·利奥·德·美第奇。

steps.text: 1524: Worked in Bologna on an Arabic–Hebrew–Latin dictionary and other scholarly projects.
steps.text_zh: 1524年，在博洛尼亚编纂阿拉伯语、希伯来语、拉丁语词典等学术著作。

steps.text: 1526: Finished in Rome his Description of Africa, Europe's main source on North and West Africa for generations.
steps.text_zh: 1526年，在罗马完成《非洲志》，此后数代欧洲人了解北非和西非主要靠这部书。

steps.text: 1527: Around the Sack of Rome he left Italy, probably returning to North Africa and perhaps to Tunis, where he is thought to have died after 1550; his end is uncertain.
steps.text_zh: 1527年前后，约在罗马之劫时离开意大利，一说回到北非突尼斯，可能卒于1550年后，晚年行迹不详。

title: Garibaldi's life journey
summary: A sailor from Nice who fought for liberty in South America and Italy, led the Thousand to conquer Sicily and Naples, and ended his days on Caprera.
summary_zh: 尼斯水手出身，在南美和意大利为自由而战，率“千人团”拿下西西里和那不勒斯，晚年隐居卡普雷拉岛。

steps.text: 1807: Born in Nice, then under French rule, to a family of seafarers; he went to sea young.
steps.text_zh: 1807年，生于当时属法国的尼斯，出身航海人家，少年即出海。

steps.text: 1834: A follower of Mazzini, he joined a failed republican rising in Piedmont-Sardinia and fled; he was sentenced to death in absentia in Genoa.
steps.text_zh: 1834年，追随马志尼参加皮埃蒙特-撒丁的共和起义，失败后出逃，在热那亚被缺席判处死刑。

steps.text: 1836: Arrived in exile in Rio de Janeiro and soon took up the cause of the rebel Riograndense Republic.
steps.text_zh: 1836年，流亡到里约热内卢，不久投身南里奥格兰德共和国的起义。

steps.text: 1839: Fought at sea and on land for the rebels at Laguna, where he met Anita, who became his wife and comrade in arms.
steps.text_zh: 1839年，在拉古纳为起义者水陆作战，在此结识了后来成为妻子和战友的安妮塔。

steps.text: 1843: In besieged Montevideo he formed the Italian Legion, whose red shirts became his trademark.
steps.text_zh: 1843年，在被围的蒙得维的亚组建意大利军团，红衫从此成为他的标志。

steps.text: 1849: Back in Italy after the 1848 revolutions, he led the defence of the Roman Republic against the French on the Janiculum.
steps.text_zh: 1849年，1848年革命后回到意大利，在贾尼科洛山指挥保卫罗马共和国、抵抗法军。

steps.place_zh: 拉文纳附近的曼德里奥莱
steps.text: 1849: Retreating with Austrian forces in pursuit, he lost Anita, who died near Ravenna; he escaped into exile again.
steps.text_zh: 1849年，在奥军追击下撤退，安妮塔死于拉文纳附近，他再次流亡海外。

steps.text: 1850: Lived on Staten Island, working in Antonio Meucci's candle factory, before going back to sea as a merchant captain.
steps.text_zh: 1850年，住在纽约斯塔滕岛，在梅乌奇的蜡烛厂做工，后重新出海当商船船长。

steps.text: 1860: Landed at Marsala with the Thousand volunteers and conquered Sicily from the Bourbon kingdom within weeks.
steps.text_zh: 1860年，率“千人团”志愿军在马尔萨拉登陆，数周内从波旁王朝手中夺下西西里。

steps.text: 1860: Entered Naples in September, then handed his conquests to King Victor Emmanuel II at Teano, making a united Italy possible.
steps.text_zh: 1860年9月，进入那不勒斯，随后在泰阿诺把征服之地交给国王维托里奥·埃马努埃莱二世，促成意大利统一。

steps.text: 1862: Marching on Rome without royal approval, he was stopped and wounded by Italian troops at Aspromonte.
steps.text_zh: 1862年，未经国王许可进军罗马，在阿斯普罗蒙特被意大利王国军队拦截并负伤。

steps.text: 1882: Died on Caprera, the small island off Sardinia where he had farmed between campaigns since the 1850s.
steps.text_zh: 1882年，在撒丁岛外的小岛卡普雷拉去世，自1850年代起他在征战间隙一直在此务农。

title: The Buddha's wanderings
summary: From a princely birth in the Himalayan foothills, the Buddha walked the Ganges plain for some forty-five years teaching the path he found under the bodhi tree.
summary_zh: 释迦牟尼生于喜马拉雅山麓的王族，悟道之后在恒河平原游行说法约四十五年。

steps.text: 563 BC: By tradition, born in the Lumbini grove to Queen Maya of the Shakya clan.
steps.text_zh: 前563年，据传生于蓝毗尼园，母亲是释迦族的摩耶夫人。

steps.text: 534 BC: Raised as a prince in Kapilavastu, at about twenty-nine he left his palace, wife and son to seek release from suffering.
steps.text_zh: 前534年，在迦毗罗卫城长大的悉达多太子，约二十九岁时舍弃王宫与妻儿，出家寻求解脱之道。

steps.text: 528 BC: After years of extreme austerity, he sat beneath a pipal tree at Uruvela and attained enlightenment.
steps.text_zh: 前528年，历经多年苦行之后，他在优楼频螺的菩提树下静坐，终于成道。

steps.text: 528 BC: In the Deer Park near Varanasi he preached his first sermon to five former companions, founding the Sangha.
steps.text_zh: 前528年，在波罗奈附近的鹿野苑为五位旧日同伴初转法轮，僧团由此建立。

steps.text: 527 BC: By tradition, King Bimbisara of Magadha became his patron and gave the order the Bamboo Grove outside Rajagriha.
steps.text_zh: 前527年，据传摩揭陀国王频毗娑罗皈依佛陀，在王舍城外布施竹林精舍。

steps.text: c. 520 BC: At Shravasti the merchant Anathapindika donated the Jetavana grove, where the Buddha spent more rainy seasons than anywhere else.
steps.text_zh: 约前520年，舍卫城富商给孤独长者布施祇园精舍，佛陀此后在这里度过的雨季安居最多。

steps.text: 484 BC: Spending his last rainy season near Vaishali, the aged Buddha announced that his death was near.
steps.text_zh: 前484年，年迈的佛陀在毗舍离附近度过最后一个雨季，宣告自己不久将入灭。

steps.text: 483 BC: He died between twin sala trees at Kushinagar, about eighty years old; his relics were divided among eight kingdoms.
steps.text_zh: 前483年，在拘尸那罗的娑罗双树间入灭，享年约八十岁，舍利分归八国供奉。

title: Ashoka's life
summary: A Mauryan prince who won the throne by force, Ashoka turned after the slaughter in Kalinga to the Dharma and carved his message across the subcontinent.
summary_zh: 阿育王以武力夺得孔雀王朝王位，羯陵伽之战的杀戮让他转向佛法，并把敕令刻遍整个次大陆。

steps.text: 304 BC: Born in Pataliputra, grandson of Chandragupta, founder of the Maurya Empire.
steps.text_zh: 前304年，生于华氏城，是孔雀王朝开国君主旃陀罗笈多的孙子。

steps.text: c. 285 BC: By tradition he served as viceroy at Ujjain, and his son Mahinda was born to Devi of nearby Vidisha.
steps.text_zh: 约前285年，据传他以王子身份出镇邬阇衍那，与附近毗底沙城的提毗生下儿子摩哂陀。

steps.text: 268 BC: After a bitter succession struggle among Bindusara's sons, he was crowned emperor in Pataliputra.
steps.text_zh: 前268年，频头娑罗诸子争位，他胜出后在华氏城登基。

steps.text: 261 BC: His conquest of Kalinga killed and uprooted hundreds of thousands; he later recorded his remorse in an edict.
steps.text_zh: 前261年，征服羯陵伽，死伤与流徙者数以十万计，他后来在敕令中表达了深切的悔恨。

steps.text: 259 BC: In his tenth regnal year he went to Sambodhi, the site of the Buddha's enlightenment, beginning his tours of Dharma.
steps.text_zh: 前259年，即位第十年，他前往佛陀成道之地菩提伽耶朝圣，从此开始巡行弘法。

steps.text: 258 BC: His rock edicts on non-violence and moral rule were carved from Girnar in the west to Kalinga in the east and Kandahar in the north-west.
steps.text_zh: 前258年，宣扬不杀生与以法治国的摩崖敕令，西起吉尔纳尔，东至羯陵伽，西北远到坎大哈，刻遍帝国各地。

steps.text: c. 250 BC: By Buddhist tradition, he sponsored the Third Council at Pataliputra and sent missionaries to lands beyond the empire.
steps.text_zh: 约前250年，据佛教传统，他在华氏城支持召开第三次结集，并向帝国以外派遣传教僧人。

steps.text: c. 250 BC: His son Mahinda carried Buddhism to Sri Lanka, converting King Devanampiya Tissa at Anuradhapura.
steps.text_zh: 约前250年，他的儿子摩哂陀把佛教带到斯里兰卡，在阿努拉德普勒使天爱帝须王皈依。

steps.text: 249 BC: In his twentieth regnal year he visited the Buddha's birthplace and raised an inscribed pillar there.
steps.text_zh: 前249年，即位第二十年，他亲临佛陀诞生地蓝毗尼，立石柱刻铭纪念。

steps.text: 232 BC: Died at Pataliputra after some thirty-seven years on the throne; the empire broke up within decades.
steps.text_zh: 前232年，在位约三十七年后卒于华氏城，此后数十年间帝国逐渐瓦解。

title: Timur's campaigns
summary: Born to a minor Turkic-Mongol clan near Samarkand, Timur spent thirty-five years campaigning from Delhi to Anatolia and died marching on Ming China.
summary_zh: 帖木儿出身撒马尔罕附近一个突厥化蒙古小部落，三十五年间征战四方，从德里打到安纳托利亚，最后死在远征明朝的路上。

steps.text: 1336: Born near Kesh, south of Samarkand, into the Barlas clan.
steps.text_zh: 1336年，生于撒马尔罕以南的渴石附近，属巴鲁剌思部。

steps.text: 1370: After taking Balkh from his rival Amir Husayn, he was proclaimed sovereign of the Chagatai lands and made Samarkand his capital.
steps.text_zh: 1370年，攻下劲敌忽辛埃米尔据守的巴尔赫，被推举为察合台汗国的主宰，定都撒马尔罕。

steps.text: 1381: Herat surrendered to him, opening his conquest of Khorasan and Persia.
steps.text_zh: 1381年，赫拉特投降，他由此开始征服呼罗珊和波斯。

steps.text: 1387: When Isfahan revolted against his garrison, his troops massacred the city and piled towers of skulls.
steps.text_zh: 1387年，伊斯法罕起事反抗他的驻军，他下令屠城，以人头筑塔。

steps.text: 1395: He crushed his former protégé Tokhtamysh of the Golden Horde on the Terek, then sacked Sarai and other Horde cities.
steps.text_zh: 1395年，在捷列克河大败昔日受他扶植的金帐汗脱脱迷失，随后洗劫萨莱等金帐汗国城市。

steps.text: 1398: He invaded India and sacked Delhi, carrying off artisans and treasure to Samarkand.
steps.text_zh: 1398年，入侵印度，洗劫德里，把工匠和财宝掳回撒马尔罕。

steps.text: 1399: Back in Samarkand he ordered the vast Bibi-Khanym Mosque, built with the spoils of India.
steps.text_zh: 1399年，回到撒马尔罕，用印度的战利品兴建宏伟的比比哈努姆清真寺。

steps.text: 1401: Damascus fell after a siege; the city was plundered and burned. The historian Ibn Khaldun met him outside the walls.
steps.text_zh: 1401年，大马士革在围攻后陷落，遭劫掠焚烧。史学家伊本·赫勒敦曾在城外与他会面。

steps.text: 1401: Baghdad, which had defied him, was stormed and its people massacred.
steps.text_zh: 1401年，抗命不降的巴格达被攻破，居民惨遭屠戮。

steps.text: 1402: At Ankara he routed the Ottoman army and captured Sultan Bayezid I.
steps.text_zh: 1402年，在安卡拉击溃奥斯曼军队，俘虏苏丹巴耶济德一世。

steps.text: 1405: Setting out in winter to invade Ming China, he fell ill and died at Otrar.
steps.text_zh: 1405年，冬季出兵远征明朝，途中在讹答剌病逝。

title: Gandhi's journeys
summary: Gandhi trained as a lawyer in London, forged satyagraha in South Africa, and led India's mass movements from Champaran to the Salt March before his murder in Delhi.
summary_zh: 甘地在伦敦学习法律，在南非创立“非暴力抵抗”，回国后从查姆帕兰到食盐进军领导了印度的群众运动，最终在德里遇刺。

steps.text: 1869: Born in Porbandar, a small Gujarati princely state, where his father was chief minister.
steps.text_zh: 1869年，生于古吉拉特小土邦博尔本德尔，父亲是土邦首相。

steps.text: 1888: Sailed to London to study law at the Inner Temple; called to the bar in 1891.
steps.text_zh: 1888年，远赴伦敦，在内殿律师学院学习法律，1891年取得律师资格。

steps.text: 1893: Working for an Indian firm in South Africa, he was thrown off a first-class train at Pietermaritzburg, a turning point in his life.
steps.text_zh: 1893年，受雇于南非一家印度商行，在彼得马里茨堡因肤色被赶下头等车厢，这成为他一生的转折点。

steps.text: 1906: At a mass meeting in Johannesburg, Indians vowed to resist the new pass law; his method of satyagraha took shape.
steps.text_zh: 1906年，在约翰内斯堡的集会上，印度侨民宣誓抵制新的登记法令，他的“非暴力抵抗”由此成形。

steps.text: 1915: Returned to India and founded an ashram at Ahmedabad, later moved to the banks of the Sabarmati.
steps.text_zh: 1915年，回到印度，在艾哈迈达巴德创办修道院，后迁至萨巴尔马蒂河畔。

steps.text: 1917: Took up the cause of indigo farmers in Champaran, Bihar — his first satyagraha campaign in India.
steps.text_zh: 1917年，在比哈尔邦查姆帕兰为靛蓝农民请命，这是他在印度的第一次非暴力抵抗运动。

steps.text: 1920: At the Congress session in Calcutta he won support for nationwide non-cooperation with British rule.
steps.text_zh: 1920年，在加尔各答的国大党特别会议上，推动通过全国性的不合作运动。

steps.text: 1930: Led the 24-day Salt March from Sabarmati to the sea at Dandi, defying the British salt tax.
steps.text_zh: 1930年，从萨巴尔马蒂步行24天到海边的丹迪，亲手煮盐，公开反抗英国的盐税。

steps.text: 1931: Attended the Second Round Table Conference in London as Congress's sole representative.
steps.text_zh: 1931年，作为国大党唯一代表赴伦敦出席第二次圆桌会议。

steps.text: 1942: In Bombay he launched the Quit India movement and was arrested within hours.
steps.text_zh: 1942年，在孟买发起“退出印度”运动，数小时后即被捕。

steps.text: 1946: Walked village to village in riot-torn Noakhali, East Bengal, trying to stop communal killing.
steps.text_zh: 1946年，在骚乱不断的东孟加拉诺阿卡利逐村步行，努力平息教派仇杀。

steps.text: 1948: Shot dead at a prayer meeting in Delhi by a Hindu nationalist, months after independence and partition.
steps.text_zh: 1948年，独立与分治后不久，在德里的祈祷会上被一名印度教民族主义者枪杀。

title: Guru Nanak's journeys
summary: The founder of Sikhism left his post at Sultanpur to travel for years across India and beyond, then settled as a farmer-teacher at Kartarpur on the Ravi.
summary_zh: 锡克教创始人那纳克辞去苏丹布尔的职务，多年游历印度内外，晚年定居拉维河畔的卡尔塔尔布尔，一边务农一边传道。

steps.place_zh: 塔尔万迪（南卡纳萨希布）
steps.text: 1469: Born in the village of Talwandi near Lahore, son of a Hindu village accountant.
steps.text_zh: 1469年，生于拉合尔附近的塔尔万迪村，父亲是村里的印度教记账员。

steps.text: 1499: While working as a storekeeper at Sultanpur, he vanished into the Bein stream and emerged, by tradition, proclaiming "there is no Hindu, there is no Muslim."
steps.text_zh: 1499年，在苏丹布尔做仓库管理员时，据传他没入贝恩河三日，出水后宣告“既无印度教徒，也无穆斯林”。

steps.text: c. 1502: By tradition, on his first long journey east with the Muslim minstrel Mardana, he debated with holy men at Varanasi.
steps.text_zh: 约1502年，据传他与穆斯林乐师马尔达纳一起东游，途经瓦拉纳西与各派修行者论道。

steps.text: c. 1518: Sikh tradition holds that on a westward journey he reached Mecca, teaching that God is in every direction.
steps.text_zh: 约1518年，锡克教传说他西行到达麦加，教导人们神无所不在。

steps.text: c. 1519: By tradition he also visited Baghdad, where a shrine later marked his stay.
steps.text_zh: 约1519年，据传他还到过巴格达，当地后来建有纪念他驻留的圣祠。

steps.place_zh: 赛义德布尔（埃米纳巴德）
steps.text: 1520: He witnessed Babur's army sack Saidpur and lamented the slaughter in his hymns.
steps.text_zh: 1520年，亲眼目睹巴布尔大军洗劫赛义德布尔，在赞歌中哀悼这场屠杀。

steps.text: 1539: From about 1522 he lived at Kartarpur, farming and teaching a community of disciples; he died there after naming Angad his successor.
steps.text_zh: 1539年，约自1522年起，他定居卡尔塔尔布尔，带领信众耕作修行，指定安加德为继承人后在此去世。

title: Kūkai's journeys
summary: From Shikoku's coast to Tang Chang'an and back, Kūkai brought esoteric Buddhism to Japan and founded the Shingon centre on Mount Kōya.
summary_zh: 空海从四国海滨出发，远赴唐都长安求法，归国后传播密教，在高野山开创真言宗道场。

steps.text: 774: Born in Sanuki province on Shikoku, into the Saeki clan.
steps.text_zh: 774年，生于四国赞岐国，出身佐伯氏。

steps.text: 791: At about eighteen he entered the state academy in the capital to study the Confucian classics, but soon left it.
steps.text_zh: 791年，约十八岁时进入京城的大学寮学习儒家经典，不久便弃学。

steps.text: c. 795: By his own account he practised austerities in Shikoku's mountains and at Cape Muroto, turning from Confucian learning to Buddhism.
steps.text_zh: 约795年，据他自述，曾在四国山林和室户岬苦修，从此由儒学转向佛门。

steps.text: 804: His envoy ship was blown off course and landed on the Fujian coast after a month at sea.
steps.text_zh: 804年，随遣唐使船出海，遭风漂流一个多月，在福建赤岸靠岸。

steps.text: 804: Reaching Chang'an, he became the disciple of the master Huiguo at Qinglong Temple and received full esoteric initiation.
steps.text_zh: 804年，抵达长安，后在青龙寺拜惠果为师，得受密教灌顶。

steps.text: 806: Returned to Kyushu with scriptures, mandalas and ritual implements, waiting at Dazaifu before being summoned to the capital.
steps.text_zh: 806年，携带经卷、曼荼罗和法器回到九州，在太宰府等候朝廷召见。

steps.text: 809: Allowed into Heian-kyō, he based himself at Takaosan-ji and won the favour of Emperor Saga.
steps.text_zh: 809年，获准进入平安京，住持高雄山寺，深得嵯峨天皇器重。

steps.text: 816: The court granted him Mount Kōya to found a monastery for meditation.
steps.text_zh: 816年，朝廷将高野山赐予他，建立修禅道场。

steps.text: 821: Sent home to Sanuki, he directed the rebuilding of the great Mannō-ike reservoir.
steps.text_zh: 821年，奉命回到故乡赞岐，主持修复满浓池大水库。

steps.text: 823: Emperor Saga gave him Tō-ji in the capital, which became a centre of Shingon.
steps.text_zh: 823年，嵯峨天皇将京城东寺赐给他，此后成为真言宗的中心。

steps.text: 835: He died on Mount Kōya; believers hold that he rests there in eternal meditation.
steps.text_zh: 835年，在高野山圆寂，信众相信他至今仍在那里入定。

title: Toyotomi Hideyoshi's rise
summary: A peasant's son who rose in Oda Nobunaga's service, Hideyoshi avenged his lord, unified Japan and then launched a ruinous invasion of Korea.
summary_zh: 出身农家的丰臣秀吉在织田信长麾下崛起，为主公复仇后统一日本，又发动了劳民伤财的侵朝战争。

steps.text: 1537: Born to a peasant family in Nakamura, Owari province.
steps.text_zh: 1537年，生于尾张国中村的农民家庭。

steps.text: c. 1558: By tradition he entered Oda Nobunaga's service at Kiyosu as a sandal-bearer.
steps.text_zh: 约1558年，据传他到清洲投奔织田信长，从提鞋的小卒做起。

steps.text: 1573: After the fall of the Azai, Nobunaga gave him their lands in Ōmi, where he built Nagahama Castle.
steps.text_zh: 1573年，浅井氏灭亡后，信长把近江的浅井旧领封给他，他在此修建长滨城。

steps.text: 1582: Besieging Takamatsu Castle by flooding it, he learned that Nobunaga had been killed at Honnō-ji.
steps.text_zh: 1582年，他正水攻备中高松城，忽闻信长在本能寺遇害。

steps.text: 1582: Racing back east, he defeated the assassin Akechi Mitsuhide at Yamazaki within days.
steps.text_zh: 1582年，率军火速东返，数日后在山崎击败弑主的明智光秀。

steps.text: 1583: Began building Osaka Castle on the site of the Ishiyama Hongan-ji as his seat of power.
steps.text_zh: 1583年，在石山本愿寺旧址兴建大阪城，作为权力中心。

steps.text: 1587: After subduing the Shimazu in Kyushu, he issued an edict at Hakata expelling Christian missionaries.
steps.text_zh: 1587年，平定九州岛津氏后，在博多颁布驱逐传教士令。

steps.text: 1590: The siege of the Hōjō at Odawara completed the unification of Japan under his rule.
steps.text_zh: 1590年，围攻小田原北条氏，日本至此在他手中统一。

steps.text: 1592: From his new base at Nagoya in Hizen, he sent armies across the strait to invade Korea.
steps.text_zh: 1592年，坐镇肥前名护屋城，派大军渡海入侵朝鲜。

steps.text: 1598: He died at Fushimi Castle, south of Kyoto, and Japanese forces soon withdrew from Korea.
steps.text_zh: 1598年，在京都以南的伏见城病逝，日军随即撤出朝鲜。

title: Matsuo Bashō's journeys
summary: Bashō left provincial Iga to make his name as a poet in Edo, then spent his last decade on foot, turning journeys into haiku travel diaries.
summary_zh: 松尾芭蕉离开伊贺故乡，在江户成名，晚年十年间徒步漫游，把旅途写成俳句纪行。

steps.text: 1644: Born in Iga province into a family of low-ranking samurai stock.
steps.text_zh: 1644年，生于伊贺国，家族是地位不高的武士出身。

steps.text: 1672: Moved to Edo, where he made his name as a haikai master; in 1680 he settled in a hut at Fukagawa.
steps.text_zh: 1672年，移居江户，以俳谐宗匠成名，1680年迁入深川的草庵。

steps.text: 1684: Set off on his first great journey, recorded in Nozarashi Kikō, visiting the Ise shrines and his old home in Iga.
steps.text_zh: 1684年，开始第一次长途旅行，写成《野晒纪行》，参拜伊势神宫并回到故乡伊贺。

steps.text: 1689: Sold his hut and left Fukagawa with his disciple Sora for the far north.
steps.text_zh: 1689年，卖掉草庵，与弟子曾良从深川出发，前往奥州。

steps.text: 1689: Reached the island-studded bay of Matsushima, which he ranked among Japan's most beautiful sights.
steps.text_zh: 1689年，抵达岛屿星罗棋布的松岛，称其为日本第一美景。

steps.text: 1689: At Hiraizumi, among the ruins of the Fujiwara, he wrote "summer grasses — all that remains of warriors' dreams."
steps.text_zh: 1689年，在平泉凭吊藤原氏遗迹，写下“夏草や兵どもが夢の跡”。

steps.text: 1689: At the mountain temple of Risshaku-ji he wrote his haiku on the cicada's voice seeping into the rocks.
steps.text_zh: 1689年，在立石寺写下蝉声“渗入岩石”的名句。

steps.text: 1689: Ended the five-month journey at Ōgaki; the account became Oku no Hosomichi.
steps.text_zh: 1689年，在大垣结束五个月的旅程，后写成《奥之细道》。

steps.text: 1690: Lived for months at the Genjūan hut near Lake Biwa, which he described in a celebrated prose piece.
steps.text_zh: 1690年，在琵琶湖畔的幻住庵住了数月，并写下名篇《幻住庵记》。

steps.text: 1694: Fell ill on a journey and died in Osaka; his last poem spoke of dreams wandering over withered fields.
steps.text_zh: 1694年，旅途中病倒，在大阪去世，绝笔之句写梦魂犹在枯野上徘徊。

title: Yi Sun-sin's life
summary: Yi Sun-sin served on Korea's northern frontier before commanding the Joseon navy, whose victories cut Japan's sea lanes during the Imjin War; he fell in its last battle.
summary_zh: 李舜臣早年戍守北方边境，后执掌朝鲜水军，在壬辰战争中屡败日军、切断其海上补给，最终战死于最后一役。

steps.text: 1545: Born in Hanseong, the Joseon capital, to a yangban family of modest means.
steps.text_zh: 1545年，生于朝鲜都城汉城一个家道中落的两班家庭。

steps.text: 1587: Commanding a post on the Tumen River, he fought off a Jurchen raid on Nokdun Island but was blamed and demoted.
steps.text_zh: 1587年，在图们江边的造山堡任职，击退女真人对鹿屯岛的袭击，却被问罪降职。

steps.text: 1591: Appointed naval commander of Left Jeolla, he trained his fleet at Yeosu and built turtle ships.
steps.text_zh: 1591年，出任全罗左道水军节度使，在丽水练兵并建造龟船。

steps.text: 1592: Weeks after the Japanese landed, he won his first victory at Okpo off Geoje Island.
steps.text_zh: 1592年，日军登陆数周后，他在巨济岛外的玉浦取得首胜。

steps.text: 1592: His crane-wing formation destroyed a Japanese fleet off Hansan Island; he later made the island his headquarters.
steps.text_zh: 1592年，以鹤翼阵在闲山岛海域全歼一支日本舰队，此后以闲山岛为水军大本营。

steps.text: 1597: Accused of disobeying orders, he was arrested, tortured in Hanseong and stripped of rank.
steps.text_zh: 1597年，被诬抗命，押解汉城受刑审讯，革去官职。

steps.text: 1597: Restored to command with only thirteen ships, he defeated a far larger Japanese fleet in the Myeongnyang Strait.
steps.text_zh: 1597年，复职后仅剩十三艘战船，在鸣梁海峡击败数倍于己的日本舰队。

steps.text: 1598: Fighting the withdrawing Japanese at Noryang alongside the Ming navy, he was killed by a bullet at the moment of victory.
steps.text_zh: 1598年，与明朝水军在露梁截击撤退的日军，胜利之际中弹殉国。

title: Hernán Cortés's expeditions
summary: From Extremadura to the Caribbean, Cortés led the conquest of the Aztec Empire, then explored Honduras and the Pacific coast before dying in Spain.
summary_zh: 科尔特斯从埃斯特雷马杜拉来到加勒比，率众征服阿兹特克帝国，又远征洪都拉斯、探索太平洋沿岸，最后死于西班牙。

steps.text: 1485: Born in Medellín, Extremadura, to a family of minor nobility.
steps.text_zh: 1485年，生于西班牙埃斯特雷马杜拉的梅德林，家族属于小贵族。

steps.text: 1511: Having come to Hispaniola in 1504, he joined Diego Velázquez's conquest of Cuba and became an official of Santiago, from where his Mexican expedition later sailed.
steps.text_zh: 1511年，他1504年来到伊斯帕尼奥拉岛，此时随贝拉斯克斯征服古巴，后在圣地亚哥任职，日后的墨西哥远征也从这里出发。

steps.text: 1519: Landed on the Gulf coast, founded Villa Rica de la Vera Cruz and scuttled his ships to prevent retreat.
steps.text_zh: 1519年，在墨西哥湾登陆，建立韦拉克鲁斯镇，并凿沉船只以断退路。

steps.text: 1519: After hard fighting, the Tlaxcalans became his allies against their Aztec enemies.
steps.text_zh: 1519年，经过激战，特拉斯卡拉人转而与他结盟，共同对抗宿敌阿兹特克。

steps.text: 1520: Received by Moctezuma in November 1519, he held the emperor captive until an uprising drove the Spaniards out on the Noche Triste.
steps.text_zh: 1520年，他于1519年11月入城受到蒙特苏马接待，随即将其软禁，直到城中起义，西班牙人在“悲痛之夜”狼狈出逃。

steps.text: 1521: From his base at Texcoco he launched brigantines onto the lake to blockade the Aztec capital.
steps.text_zh: 1521年，以特斯科科为基地，在湖上放下双桅帆船，封锁阿兹特克都城。

steps.text: 1521: After a long siege, ravaged by smallpox, Tenochtitlan fell; Mexico City was built on its ruins.
steps.text_zh: 1521年，城中天花肆虐，经长期围攻后特诺奇蒂特兰陷落，墨西哥城在废墟上建立。

steps.text: 1525: Led a gruelling overland march to Honduras to punish a rebellious lieutenant, during which he executed the captive Cuauhtémoc.
steps.text_zh: 1525年，为惩治叛变的部下，率军艰难跋涉至洪都拉斯，途中处死被俘的夸乌特莫克。

steps.text: 1528: Returned to Spain to defend himself at court before Charles V, who made him Marquis of the Valley of Oaxaca.
steps.text_zh: 1528年，回西班牙向查理五世当面申辩，被封为瓦哈卡谷侯爵。

steps.text: 1535: Led an expedition across the sea to Baja California and tried to found a colony at the Bay of La Paz.
steps.text_zh: 1535年，率船队横渡海湾到达下加利福尼亚，试图在拉巴斯湾建立殖民地。

steps.text: 1541: Joined Charles V's disastrous expedition against Algiers.
steps.text_zh: 1541年，随查理五世出征阿尔及尔，大败而归。

steps.place_zh: 卡斯蒂列哈-德拉库埃斯塔
steps.text: 1547: Died near Seville while preparing to return to Mexico.
steps.text_zh: 1547年，准备返回墨西哥时，病逝于塞维利亚附近。

title: Simón Bolívar's campaigns
summary: Bolívar swore in Rome to free Spanish America and fought for two decades across the northern Andes, from Caracas to Upper Peru.
summary_zh: 玻利瓦尔在罗马立誓解放西属美洲，此后二十年转战安第斯山北部，从加拉加斯一直打到上秘鲁。

steps.text: 1783: Born in Caracas to a wealthy Creole family; orphaned as a child.
steps.text_zh: 1783年，生于加拉加斯一个富有的土生白人家庭，幼年父母双亡。

steps.text: 1799: Sent to Madrid to complete his education; he married there in 1802, but his wife died within a year of returning to Venezuela.
steps.text_zh: 1799年，被送往马德里求学，1802年在此成婚，回委内瑞拉不到一年妻子病逝。

steps.text: 1805: On Monte Sacro in Rome he vowed not to rest until Spanish America was free.
steps.text_zh: 1805年，在罗马圣山上立誓，不使西属美洲获得自由誓不罢休。

steps.text: 1812: After the fall of the First Venezuelan Republic he fled to Cartagena and issued his Cartagena Manifesto.
steps.text_zh: 1812年，委内瑞拉第一共和国覆灭后，他逃往卡塔赫纳，发表《卡塔赫纳宣言》。

steps.text: 1815: In exile in Jamaica he wrote the Jamaica Letter, sketching the future of independent Spanish America.
steps.text_zh: 1815年，流亡牙买加期间写下《牙买加来信》，构想独立后的西属美洲。

steps.text: 1819: At the Congress of Angostura on the Orinoco he laid out his republic; Gran Colombia was proclaimed there that December.
steps.text_zh: 1819年，在奥里诺科河畔召开安戈斯图拉国会，阐述共和构想；同年12月，大哥伦比亚在此宣告成立。

steps.text: 1819: After crossing the Andes in the rainy season, he won the decisive battle of Boyacá and entered Bogotá.
steps.text_zh: 1819年，雨季翻越安第斯山，在博亚卡决战获胜，随即进入波哥大。

steps.text: 1821: His victory at Carabobo secured the independence of Venezuela.
steps.text_zh: 1821年，卡拉沃沃大捷，委内瑞拉独立就此确定。

steps.text: 1822: Met José de San Martín in private at Guayaquil; San Martín soon withdrew, leaving him to finish the war in Peru.
steps.text_zh: 1822年，在瓜亚基尔与圣马丁密谈，不久圣马丁引退，秘鲁的战事交由他完成。

steps.text: 1824: Led the patriot cavalry to victory at Junín in the high Andes, months before Sucre's triumph at Ayacucho.
steps.text_zh: 1824年，在安第斯高原的胡宁率骑兵取胜，数月后苏克雷在阿亚库乔赢得决战。

steps.text: 1825: Upper Peru declared independence and named itself Bolivia in his honour; he toured the new republic and drafted its constitution.
steps.text_zh: 1825年，上秘鲁宣布独立，以他的名字定国名为玻利维亚，他巡视新共和国并起草宪法。

steps.text: 1830: As Gran Colombia broke apart, he resigned and died of tuberculosis near Santa Marta on his way into exile.
steps.text_zh: 1830年，大哥伦比亚分崩离析，他辞职后准备出国，途中在圣玛尔塔附近死于肺结核。

title: José de San Martín's campaigns
summary: Trained as a Spanish officer, San Martín returned to lead the Army of the Andes, freeing Argentina, Chile and Peru before retiring to European exile.
summary_zh: 圣马丁早年是西班牙军官，回国后率领安第斯军解放阿根廷、智利和秘鲁，晚年隐退欧洲。

steps.text: 1778: Born at Yapeyú, a former Jesuit mission on the Uruguay River, where his father was governor.
steps.text_zh: 1778年，生于乌拉圭河畔的耶稣会旧传教村亚佩尤，父亲是当地长官。

steps.text: 1808: After two decades in the Spanish army, he fought against Napoleon's forces at the victory of Bailén.
steps.text_zh: 1808年，在西班牙军中服役二十年后，参加拜伦战役击败拿破仑的军队。

steps.text: 1812: Sailed to Buenos Aires to join the independence cause and raised the Regiment of Mounted Grenadiers.
steps.text_zh: 1812年，乘船来到布宜诺斯艾利斯投身独立事业，组建骑马掷弹兵团。

steps.text: 1813: His grenadiers defeated a royalist landing at San Lorenzo on the Paraná, his first battle in America.
steps.text_zh: 1813年，率掷弹兵在巴拉那河畔的圣洛伦索击退保王军登陆，这是他在美洲的第一战。

steps.text: 1814: As governor of Cuyo in Mendoza he spent nearly three years building the Army of the Andes.
steps.text_zh: 1814年，出任库约省长，在门多萨用近三年时间组建安第斯军。

steps.text: 1817: After crossing the Andes, he defeated the royalists at Chacabuco and entered Santiago.
steps.text_zh: 1817年，翻越安第斯山后在查卡布科大败保王军，进入圣地亚哥。

steps.text: 1818: The victory at Maipú secured Chile's independence.
steps.text_zh: 1818年，迈普大捷，智利独立得以巩固。

steps.text: 1821: Having landed in Peru by sea, he proclaimed its independence in Lima and became Protector.
steps.text_zh: 1821年，从海路登陆秘鲁，在利马宣布秘鲁独立，出任护国公。

steps.text: 1822: After his closed-door meeting with Bolívar at Guayaquil, he resigned his command and left Peru.
steps.text_zh: 1822年，与玻利瓦尔在瓜亚基尔闭门会谈后，辞去兵权，离开秘鲁。

steps.text: 1824: Sailed to Europe with his young daughter and settled in Brussels.
steps.text_zh: 1824年，带着幼女远赴欧洲，定居布鲁塞尔。

steps.text: 1850: After years near Paris, he died at Boulogne-sur-Mer in northern France.
steps.text_zh: 1850年，在巴黎近郊住了多年后，于法国北部的滨海布洛涅去世。

title: George Washington's life
summary: A Virginia planter-surveyor who learned war on the frontier, Washington led the Continental Army to victory and became the first president of the United States.
summary_zh: 华盛顿本是弗吉尼亚的种植园主和测量员，在边疆战争中历练成长，后率大陆军赢得独立战争，成为美国首任总统。

steps.text: 1732: Born on his father's plantation at Popes Creek, Westmoreland County, Virginia.
steps.text_zh: 1732年，生于弗吉尼亚威斯特摩兰县教皇溪畔父亲的种植园。

steps.text: 1753: Sent by Virginia's governor to warn the French to leave the Ohio country, he travelled through the winter wilderness to Fort Le Boeuf.
steps.text_zh: 1753年，受弗吉尼亚总督派遣，冒着严冬穿越荒野到勒伯夫堡，要求法军撤出俄亥俄地区。

steps.text: 1754: After a skirmish with French troops, he was forced to surrender Fort Necessity — an opening clash of the French and Indian War.
steps.text_zh: 1754年，与法军交火后被迫交出必需堡，这是英法北美战争最初的冲突之一。

steps.text: 1755: Serving with General Braddock, he rallied the survivors after the British army was routed near the Monongahela.
steps.text_zh: 1755年，随布拉多克将军出征，英军在莫农加希拉河畔惨败，他收拢残部撤退。

steps.text: 1759: Married the widow Martha Custis and settled as a planter at Mount Vernon on the Potomac.
steps.text_zh: 1759年，娶寡妇玛莎·卡斯蒂斯为妻，在波托马克河畔的弗农山庄经营种植园。

steps.text: 1775: Named commander-in-chief by Congress, he took command of the Continental Army at Cambridge during the siege of Boston.
steps.text_zh: 1775年，被大陆会议任命为总司令，在波士顿围城期间于剑桥接掌大陆军。

steps.text: 1776: On Christmas night he crossed the icy Delaware and surprised the Hessian garrison at Trenton.
steps.text_zh: 1776年，圣诞夜横渡结冰的特拉华河，奇袭特伦顿的黑森雇佣兵。

steps.text: 1777: His army endured a hungry winter encampment at Valley Forge and emerged better drilled.
steps.text_zh: 1777年，大陆军在福吉谷忍饥挨冻度过寒冬，经过整训后战力大增。

steps.text: 1781: With French army and fleet, he trapped Cornwallis at Yorktown, effectively winning the war.
steps.text_zh: 1781年，与法国陆海军合围约克镇，迫使康沃利斯投降，基本赢得战争。

steps.text: 1787: Presided over the Constitutional Convention in Philadelphia.
steps.text_zh: 1787年，在费城主持制宪会议。

steps.text: 1789: Sworn in as the first president of the United States at Federal Hall in New York.
steps.text_zh: 1789年，在纽约联邦大厅宣誓就任美国首任总统。

steps.text: 1799: Having declined a third term, he retired to Mount Vernon and died there; his will freed the people he had enslaved.
steps.text_zh: 1799年，拒绝第三次连任后退隐弗农山庄并在此去世，遗嘱中解放了他名下的奴隶。

title: Meriwether Lewis's expedition
summary: Jefferson's secretary Meriwether Lewis led the Corps of Discovery with William Clark from the Missouri to the Pacific and back, but died young three years later.
summary_zh: 刘易斯原是杰斐逊的秘书，与克拉克一起率领“发现军团”沿密苏里河西行到达太平洋并返回，三年后英年早逝。

steps.place_zh: 弗吉尼亚阿尔伯马尔县
steps.text: 1774: Born at Locust Hill in Albemarle County, Virginia, a neighbour county to Jefferson's Monticello.
steps.text_zh: 1774年，生于弗吉尼亚阿尔伯马尔县的洛卡斯特山庄园，与杰斐逊的蒙蒂塞洛同属一县。

steps.text: 1801: Became President Jefferson's private secretary, who chose him to lead an expedition to the Pacific.
steps.text_zh: 1801年，出任杰斐逊总统的私人秘书，后被选定率队远征太平洋。

steps.text: 1803: Oversaw the building of his keelboat at Pittsburgh and set off down the Ohio River.
steps.text_zh: 1803年，在匹兹堡督造龙骨船，随后沿俄亥俄河顺流而下。

steps.text: 1804: After wintering opposite the mouth of the Missouri, the Corps of Discovery started upriver in May.
steps.text_zh: 1804年，在密苏里河口对岸过冬后，“发现军团”于5月溯河出发。

steps.text: 1804: Wintered among the Mandan and Hidatsa villages, where Sacagawea and her husband joined the expedition.
steps.text_zh: 1804年，在曼丹人和希达察人村落旁过冬，萨卡加维亚与丈夫在此加入探险队。

steps.text: 1805: Lewis reached the Great Falls of the Missouri; carrying the boats around them took nearly a month.
steps.text_zh: 1805年，刘易斯抵达密苏里河大瀑布，绕行搬运船只耗时近一个月。

steps.text: 1805: Crossed the Continental Divide at Lemhi Pass and obtained horses from Sacagawea's Shoshone people.
steps.text_zh: 1805年，经莱姆希山口翻越大陆分水岭，从萨卡加维亚的族人肖肖尼人那里换得马匹。

steps.text: 1805: Reached the Pacific at the mouth of the Columbia and built Fort Clatsop for the winter.
steps.text_zh: 1805年，在哥伦比亚河口抵达太平洋，修建克拉特索普堡过冬。

steps.text: 1806: Exploring the Marias River on the way back, his small party had a deadly clash with Blackfeet warriors.
steps.text_zh: 1806年，返程途中考察玛丽亚斯河，他带领的小分队与黑脚族武士发生流血冲突。

steps.text: 1806: The expedition returned to St. Louis in September; Lewis was later appointed governor of Louisiana Territory there.
steps.text_zh: 1806年，探险队于9月回到圣路易斯，刘易斯后来出任路易斯安那领地总督，驻此城。

steps.text: 1809: Travelling the Natchez Trace toward Washington, he died of gunshot wounds at a roadside inn, most likely by suicide.
steps.text_zh: 1809年，沿纳奇兹小道前往华盛顿途中，在路边客栈枪伤身亡，多认为是自杀。

title: Che Guevara's journeys
summary: An Argentine doctor radicalised by travels across Latin America, Che fought in the Cuban Revolution and then tried to export guerrilla war to the Congo and Bolivia.
summary_zh: 阿根廷医生切·格瓦拉在拉美游历中走向革命，参加古巴革命后又试图把游击战带到刚果和玻利维亚。

steps.text: 1928: Born in Rosario, Argentina, to a middle-class family; he suffered from asthma all his life.
steps.text_zh: 1928年，生于阿根廷罗萨里奥的中产家庭，终生患有哮喘。

steps.text: 1952: On a long motorcycle journey with Alberto Granado he crossed Chile and Peru, visiting Machu Picchu and a leper colony on the Amazon.
steps.text_zh: 1952年，与格拉纳多骑摩托车长途旅行，穿越智利和秘鲁，到访马丘比丘和亚马孙河畔的麻风病院。

steps.text: 1953: Qualified as a doctor in Buenos Aires and set out again northward.
steps.text_zh: 1953年，在布宜诺斯艾利斯取得医学学位，随即再度北上。

steps.text: 1954: In Guatemala he witnessed the CIA-backed coup against President Árbenz.
steps.text_zh: 1954年，在危地马拉亲历美国中央情报局支持的推翻阿本斯总统的政变。

steps.text: 1955: In Mexico City he met Fidel Castro and joined his expedition to overthrow Batista.
steps.text_zh: 1955年，在墨西哥城结识菲德尔·卡斯特罗，加入推翻巴蒂斯塔的远征队。

steps.text: 1956: After the yacht Granma landed in eastern Cuba, the survivors regrouped in the Sierra Maestra.
steps.text_zh: 1956年，“格拉玛号”在古巴东部登陆，幸存者退入马埃斯特腊山重整旗鼓。

steps.text: 1958: His column captured Santa Clara, prompting Batista to flee on New Year's Day.
steps.text_zh: 1958年，他率领的纵队攻占圣克拉拉，巴蒂斯塔于元旦出逃。

steps.text: 1959: In Havana he ran La Cabaña fortress and later the national bank and the ministry of industry.
steps.text_zh: 1959年，在哈瓦那主管卡瓦尼亚要塞，后任国家银行行长和工业部长。

steps.text: 1964: Addressed the United Nations General Assembly in New York.
steps.text_zh: 1964年，在纽约联合国大会上发表演讲。

steps.text: 1965: Led Cuban volunteers to support rebels near Lake Tanganyika; the mission failed within months.
steps.text_zh: 1965年，率古巴志愿者到坦噶尼喀湖畔支援刚果叛军，数月后无功而返。

steps.text: 1967: Captured by the Bolivian army after a failing guerrilla campaign, he was executed in the village of La Higuera.
steps.text_zh: 1967年，在玻利维亚打游击失败后被政府军俘获，在伊格拉村遭处决。

title: José Rizal's journeys
summary: Rizal studied and wrote across Europe, where his novels indicted Spanish rule, then returned home to exile and execution, becoming the Philippines' national hero.
summary_zh: 黎刹在欧洲求学著述，以小说抨击西班牙殖民统治，回国后遭流放并被处决，成为菲律宾的民族英雄。

steps.text: 1861: Born in Calamba, Laguna, to a prosperous family of Chinese-Filipino descent.
steps.text_zh: 1861年，生于内湖省卡兰巴一个富裕的华裔菲律宾家庭。

steps.text: 1872: Entered the Ateneo in Manila, later studying medicine at the University of Santo Tomas.
steps.text_zh: 1872年，进入马尼拉的雅典耀学校，后在圣托马斯大学学医。

steps.text: 1882: Sailed to Spain and studied medicine and philosophy at the Central University of Madrid.
steps.text_zh: 1882年，远赴西班牙，在马德里中央大学攻读医学和哲学。

steps.text: 1886: Trained in ophthalmology in Heidelberg to treat his mother's failing eyes.
steps.text_zh: 1886年，在海德堡学习眼科，希望治好母亲的眼疾。

steps.text: 1887: Published his novel Noli Me Tángere in Berlin, an indictment of friars and colonial abuse.
steps.text_zh: 1887年，在柏林出版小说《不许犯我》，揭露修士与殖民当局的种种恶行。

steps.text: 1888: In the British Museum he copied and annotated Morga's early history of the Philippines.
steps.text_zh: 1888年，在大英博物馆抄录并注释莫尔加的早期菲律宾史。

steps.text: 1891: Printed his second novel, El Filibusterismo, in Ghent on borrowed money.
steps.text_zh: 1891年，借钱在根特印行第二部小说《起义者》。

steps.text: 1891: Practised as an eye doctor in Hong Kong before deciding to return home.
steps.text_zh: 1891年，在香港行医做眼科大夫，随后决定回国。

steps.text: 1892: Days after founding La Liga Filipina in Manila, he was arrested and exiled to Dapitan on Mindanao, where he ran a school and clinic.
steps.text_zh: 1892年，在马尼拉创立菲律宾联盟后数日即被捕，流放棉兰老岛的达皮丹，在当地办学行医。

steps.text: 1896: Accused of inspiring the revolution, he was tried and shot at Bagumbayan in Manila on 30 December.
steps.text_zh: 1896年，被指煽动革命，经审判后于12月30日在马尼拉巴贡巴延刑场被枪决。

title: Marco Polo's travels
summary: A Venetian merchant's son who crossed Asia to Kublai Khan's court, spent some seventeen years in Yuan China, sailed home by sea, and made Asia famous in Europe through the book he dictated in a Genoese prison.
summary_zh: 威尼斯商人之子，随父叔横越亚洲来到忽必烈宫廷，在元朝生活约十七年后由海路返乡，在热那亚狱中口述游记，使东方闻名欧洲。

steps.text: 1254: Born in Venice into a merchant family; his father Niccolò and uncle Maffeo were away trading in the East for most of his childhood.
steps.text_zh: 1254年，生于威尼斯商人家庭；童年时父亲尼科洛和叔叔马费奥远在东方经商，多年未归。

steps.text: 1271: Aged about seventeen, sets out with his father and uncle; at Acre they collect letters from the newly elected Pope Gregory X for Kublai Khan.
steps.text_zh: 1271年，约十七岁的马可随父叔启程东行，在阿卡领受新任教皇格列高利十世致忽必烈的书信。

steps.text: 1272: Probably around this year the party reaches Hormuz on the Persian Gulf, but decides against the sea route and turns inland across Persia.
steps.text_zh: 1272年前后，一行人到达波斯湾口的霍尔木兹，因不愿冒险走海路，转而由陆路穿越波斯。

steps.text: 1273: Probably around this year, after crossing the Pamirs, they reach Kashgar and follow the southern Silk Road along the Tarim Basin toward China.
steps.text_zh: 1273年前后，翻越帕米尔高原抵达喀什噶尔，再沿塔里木盆地南缘的丝路东行（具体年份不详）。

steps.text: 1275: Reaches Kublai Khan's summer capital at Shangdu after a journey of about three and a half years, and enters the khan's service.
steps.text_zh: 1275年，历时约三年半抵达元上都，觐见忽必烈，此后留在元廷当差。

steps.text: 1285: In these years (dates uncertain) he travels on the khan's errands in the south; his book describes the former Song capital Quinsai as the finest city in the world.
steps.text_zh: 1285年前后（年份不确），奉命往来江南各地；他在书中称南宋旧都“行在”杭州为世上最华美的城市。

steps.text: 1291: Probably early this year, sails from Zaitun with an escort taking the Mongol princess Kököchin to marry the Ilkhan of Persia — the Polos' chance to go home.
steps.text_zh: 1291年（一说1290年），从刺桐港扬帆，护送蒙古公主阔阔真远嫁波斯伊利汗，借此得以返乡。

steps.text: 1292: The fleet waits about five months on Sumatra for the monsoon to turn before crossing the Indian Ocean.
steps.text_zh: 1292年，船队在苏门答腊停泊约五个月，等候季风转向，再横渡印度洋。

steps.text: 1293: Probably around this year they reach Persia; the intended groom Arghun has died, so the princess is handed to his son Ghazan, and the Polos rest a while in Tabriz.
steps.text_zh: 1293年前后抵达波斯，原定的新郎阿鲁浑汗已死，公主改嫁其子合赞，波罗一家在大不里士停留了一段时间。

steps.text: 1295: Arrives back in Venice after twenty-four years away, reportedly with gems sewn into their clothes.
steps.text_zh: 1295年，离家二十四年后回到威尼斯；据说他们把宝石缝在衣服里带回。

steps.text: 1298: Held prisoner by the Genoese (by tradition captured in a sea battle), he dictates his travels to cellmate Rustichello of Pisa, producing the book later called The Travels of Marco Polo.
steps.text_zh: 1298年前后，成为热那亚人的俘虏（相传是在海战中被俘），在狱中向同囚的比萨人鲁斯蒂谦口述见闻，写成后世所称的《马可·波罗游记》。

steps.text: 1324: Dies in Venice; by tradition he told those urging him to retract that he had not told half of what he saw.
steps.text_zh: 1324年，卒于威尼斯；相传临终有人劝他收回夸张之辞，他说自己所见的连一半都没讲出来。

title: Ibn Battuta's travels
summary: A Moroccan legal scholar who left Tangier on pilgrimage and kept going for nearly thirty years, through Arabia, East Africa, Anatolia, India, the Maldives, China and West Africa, before dictating his famous Rihla in Fez.
summary_zh: 摩洛哥法学家，自丹吉尔出发朝觐，此后游历近三十年，足迹遍及阿拉伯、东非、小亚细亚、印度、马尔代夫、中国和西非，晚年在非斯口述成《游记》。

steps.text: 1325: Born in Tangier in 1304 to a family of Berber legal scholars, he leaves home at twenty-one, alone, on pilgrimage to Mecca.
steps.text_zh: 1325年，这位1304年生于丹吉尔、出身柏柏尔法学世家的青年，二十一岁时只身启程前往麦加朝觐。

steps.text: 1326: After Egypt and Syria, completes his first hajj at Mecca and resolves to keep travelling, vowing never to take the same road twice.
steps.text_zh: 1326年，经埃及、叙利亚抵达麦加，完成第一次朝觐，并决心继续远游，立誓“不走回头路”。

steps.text: 1331: Probably around this year (dates disputed), sails down the Swahili coast of East Africa to Mogadishu, Mombasa and Kilwa, which he calls one of the finest towns in the world.
steps.text_zh: 1331年前后（年份有争议），沿东非斯瓦希里海岸南下，经摩加迪沙、蒙巴萨到达基尔瓦，称之为世上最美的城市之一。

steps.text: 1332: Probably around this year, joins a Byzantine princess married to Özbeg Khan of the Golden Horde on her visit home to Constantinople.
steps.text_zh: 1332年前后（一说1334年），随金帐汗月即别的拜占庭籍妃子回娘家，到访君士坦丁堡。

steps.text: 1334: Reaches Delhi by way of Central Asia and Afghanistan; Sultan Muhammad bin Tughlaq makes him a qadi (judge), and he stays about eight years at the dangerous, generous court.
steps.text_zh: 1334年前后，经中亚、阿富汗抵达德里，苏丹穆罕默德·本·图格鲁克任命他为法官，他在这座既慷慨又凶险的宫廷待了约八年。

steps.text: 1343: After his embassy to China is shipwrecked off Calicut, he spends most of a year as qadi in the Maldives, marrying several times.
steps.text_zh: 1343年前后，出使中国的船队在卡利卡特附近遇难后，他辗转来到马尔代夫，任法官近一年，并在当地多次娶妻。

steps.text: 1345: Lands at Zaitun, the great port of Yuan China, where he finds a Muslim merchant community; he also describes Guangzhou and claims to have visited Hangzhou and Dadu.
steps.text_zh: 1345年前后，在元朝大港刺桐登岸，见到当地的穆斯林商人社区；他还记述了广州，并自称到过杭州和大都（后者存疑）。

steps.text: 1348: Back in the Middle East, witnesses the Black Death in Damascus, where he records some 2,400 deaths in a single day, and learns his mother has died of it in Morocco.
steps.text_zh: 1348年，回到中东，在大马士革亲历黑死病，记下一日死亡约两千四百人；随后得知母亲已在摩洛哥死于瘟疫。

steps.text: 1350: Probably around this year, after returning to Morocco in 1349, crosses to al-Andalus and visits Muslim Granada.
steps.text_zh: 1350年前后，于1349年回到摩洛哥后，又渡海到安达卢斯，游历穆斯林治下的格拉纳达。

steps.text: 1352: Crosses the Sahara to the Mali Empire, staying at the capital of Mansa Sulayman (its site is uncertain) and later visiting Timbuktu.
steps.text_zh: 1352年，穿越撒哈拉来到马里帝国，在曼萨·苏莱曼的都城（确切位置不详）停留，后又到过廷巴克图。

steps.text: 1355: In Fez, at the order of Sultan Abu Inan, his travels are written down by the scholar Ibn Juzayy as the Rihla, completed this year.
steps.text_zh: 1355年，奉马林王朝苏丹阿布·伊南之命，在非斯由学者伊本·朱扎伊笔录其游历，是年《游记》成书。

steps.text: 1369: Probably dies around this year (1368 or 1369) after serving as a judge in Morocco; by tradition he is buried in his native Tangier.
steps.text_zh: 1369年前后（一说1368年），在摩洛哥任法官多年后去世；相传葬于故乡丹吉尔。

title: Genghis Khan's campaigns
summary: Born Temüjin on the Onon River, he united the Mongol tribes in 1206 and led campaigns that broke the Jin, destroyed the Khwarazmian Empire and ended Western Xia, dying on the last campaign in 1227.
summary_zh: 原名铁木真，生于斡难河畔，1206年统一蒙古诸部，此后南下攻金、西征花剌子模、灭西夏，1227年死于征夏途中。

steps.text: 1162: Born Temüjin by tradition at Delüün Boldog on the Onon River (some sources say 1155 or 1167); after his father Yesügei was poisoned, the family was abandoned and grew up in poverty.
steps.text_zh: 1162年，相传生于斡难河畔的迭里温孛勒答黑（一说1155年或1167年），名铁木真；父亲也速该被毒死后，孤儿寡母被部众抛弃，艰难度日。

steps.text: 1206: A great kurultai at the source of the Onon proclaims him Genghis Khan, ruler of all the Mongol tribes he had united in two decades of war.
steps.text_zh: 1206年，在斡难河源召开大忽里勒台，诸部共尊他为成吉思汗，蒙古草原经二十年征战归于一统。

steps.text: 1209: Invades Western Xia and besieges its capital Zhongxing; the Xia emperor submits, gives a daughter in marriage and pays tribute.
steps.text_zh: 1209年，进攻西夏，围其都城中兴府；夏主纳女请和，称臣纳贡。

steps.text: 1211: Turns on the Jin and routs its main army at Yehuling (Badger Mouth), opening the way into north China.
steps.text_zh: 1211年，大举攻金，在野狐岭大破金军主力，打开了进入华北的门户。

steps.text: 1215: After the Jin court flees south to Kaifeng, his generals take and sack the Jin capital Zhongdu, while he himself stays north of the passes.
steps.text_zh: 1215年，金廷南迁汴京后，蒙古军攻陷金中都（今北京）并大肆焚掠；成吉思汗本人坐镇塞外。

steps.text: 1219: Avenging the massacre of his caravan at Otrar, he launches the western campaign against the Khwarazmian Empire, besieging Otrar first.
steps.text_zh: 1219年，为报讹答剌商队被杀之仇，亲率大军西征花剌子模，首先围攻讹答剌。

steps.text: 1220: Takes Bukhara and then Samarkand, the great cities of Transoxiana; Sultan Muhammad flees and dies on a Caspian island.
steps.text_zh: 1220年，攻下河中名城布哈拉，继取撒马尔罕；花剌子模苏丹摩诃末出逃，死于里海孤岛。

steps.text: 1221: Overtakes Jalal al-Din, the last Khwarazmian prince, on the Indus (probably near Attock) and crushes his army, though the prince escapes by swimming across.
steps.text_zh: 1221年，在印度河畔（大约在今阿托克一带）追上花剌子模王子札兰丁，全歼其军，札兰丁跃马泅水逃脱。

steps.text: 1222: In his camp south of the Hindu Kush he receives the Daoist master Qiu Chuji, who had travelled from Shandong, and questions him about long life.
steps.text_zh: 1222年，在兴都库什山南的行营召见从山东远道而来的全真道长丘处机，向他问长生之道。

steps.text: 1226: Returns to punish Western Xia for refusing troops, sweeps through the Hexi Corridor and defeats the Xia army near Lingzhou on the Yellow River.
steps.text_zh: 1226年，因西夏拒不出兵相助，回师讨伐，横扫河西走廊，在黄河畔灵州附近大败夏军。

steps.text: 1227: Dies in the Liupan Mountains region during the final siege of Western Xia, which falls soon after; his burial place in Mongolia remains unknown.
steps.text_zh: 1227年，在六盘山一带病逝，此时西夏已濒临灭亡，不久即亡国；他葬于蒙古故地，墓地至今未能确认。
